name: Alphagne
source:
Feeling sorry for the way Kikutarou died, she brings him back to life in another world.

Defeated by Kikutarou’s skill, she becomes a female pig and shares this other world with him.

[From [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc091/index.html]official site[/url]]
